game_title: Fallback: Split Join Assembly – Avalanche Slope
game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope, a slope primed for avalanche: the mountaineer must hold off storm winds while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Split Join Assembly: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders.
theme: Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope: a slope primed for avalanche
core_gameplay_loop: In Avalanche Slope, repeat each round: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders. Then check assembly and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ice ladder from storm winds in Avalanche Slope: keep assembly above zero until the 39-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 4 (applied tier): Split Join Assembly
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 8, Level 4, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
